usage: roborepo                       interactive menu
roborepo skill new [--kind=auto|skill-command|standalone] [--name=<name>] [--description=<text>]
roborepo skill adopt <name>
roborepo skill export-to-project [--yes] [--on-conflict=skip|override]
roborepo skill link-project      [--dry-run] [--uninstall]   link this project's .codex/skills into .claude/skills
roborepo skill sync-global                              refresh shared skill cache + harness links
roborepo skill inspect <name>                           show source, ownership, native metadata, and harness install state
roborepo skill native [--full]                          show native Claude/Codex skill and plugin entrypoints
roborepo skill audit [--check]                           render/check shared skill invocation audit
roborepo skill render-commands [--check]                   render/check slash commands
roborepo index code  [path]
roborepo index docs  [path]
roborepo mcp add <name-or-url> [--scope=user|local|project] [--name=<name>] [--dry-run] [--only-claude|--only-codex] [--skip-claude-permission]
roborepo watch code  [path]
roborepo project-context inventory [path] [--summary]   scan a repo and write generated facts
roborepo project-context check [path]                   validate generated Project Context facts/docs
roborepo onboard
roborepo web                              open the local web portal in the browser (serve --detach)
roborepo serve [--detach] [--no-open] [--port <n>]   local web portal (/config + telemetry)
roborepo enable  <package-id> [--dry-run]   wire a package (mcp/hooks/rules/permissions)
roborepo disable <package-id> [--dry-run]   remove a package's wiring
roborepo telemetry install                 wire only capture hooks (no full roborepo required)
roborepo telemetry stop                   stop detached dashboard + disable capture
roborepo telemetry enable|disable         capture toggle (power-user)
roborepo telemetry status|report|export|backup|purge
roborepo telemetry backup                snapshot the spool to a timestamped backup
roborepo telemetry purge --all [--backup] reset telemetry (optionally back up first)
roborepo run <cmd> [args...]
roborepo update  [--dry-run] [--on-conflict overwrite|keep|abort]
roborepo repair  [--dry-run] [--on-conflict overwrite|keep|abort]  refresh copied install after the repo was moved/renamed
roborepo uninstall [--dry-run]
roborepo doctor  [--installed] health check
roborepo verify                post-install verification
roborepo rules   [--check]     render/check tracked generated agent rules
roborepo rules check-home      check rendered home rules against enabled packages
roborepo permissions [--check] [--profile <name>] render/check agent permission outputs
roborepo --help | -h
[path] is optional (defaults to the current directory) and may be relative or absolute.
